caption:
Koko rushed in late, caught her breath, and the session was nearly over.

A few small habits help: arrive a few minutes early, wear clothes you can move in, and start with a quick update on how the exercises went and any flare-ups since last time. That helps your practitioner adjust the plan.

Hybi's tip: ask to practise your exercises in the session so technique can be checked, and film a short clip on your phone. Before you leave, note your top two or three priorities for the week.

Our team at Hybrid Physio shapes each session around your feedback. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
